detail.longDescription: skullwire, an open-source directory of stuff i actually care about. small web, terminal tools, self-hosting and general oddities. right now it's almost 500 repos split into a few shelves: game recomps and decomps (yes, zelda running natively on pc), browser/wasm ports and emulators, small web, indieweb and posse, self-hosted apps, atproto and fediverse, tui and cli tools, and mcp and agent skills. each one shows stars, language and when it was last updated, so you can tell what's alive and what's a fossil. no accounts, no tracking. just browse by category or ctrl+f your way through it. https://skullwire.thatsmy.tools/ # smallweb # selfhosted # opensource # indieweb # retrogaming
